name: Meeting SMS Reminders
summary: An automated assistant that sends SMS meeting reminders with links to all attendees before each calendar event.

items.title: Calendar sync
items.description: Reads upcoming meetings from your calendar to trigger the reminder process.
items.proved_when: Upcoming calendar events are fetched successfully
items.source_quote: Before each meeting on my calendar

items.title: Attendee contact directory
items.description: Stores and retrieves phone numbers for meeting attendees.
items.proved_when: Attendee phone numbers are correctly matched to calendar invitees

items.title: SMS text sender
items.description: Sends text messages containing meeting links to each attendee.
items.proved_when: SMS delivery report confirms messages sent to attendees
items.source_quote: text each attendee an SMS reminder with the meeting link

items.title: Reminder timing rule
items.description: Schedules reminders to be sent out prior to the start of each meeting.
items.proved_when: Reminders are triggered at the correct time interval before meetings

questions.text: Which SMS messaging service should be used to text attendees?

not_in_this_version.title: Interactive RSVP replies
not_in_this_version.reason: The current scope is strictly to send out reminders, not process incoming text replies.
